## Solar plant one-line

Numbers are the Node-RED cache (`solarComputedLast`), scraped as `solar_plant_watts` / `solar_plant_panel_watts`. Green cards are device clamps. Amber cards are estimates (KU MPPT 2/3, PWM, panel halves, equal share).

Arrow direction follows the sign of the bound series when the wire says so (jumper, shunt): positive = forward, negative = reverse, zero = no arrow. Other wires are fixed forward. Grafana Canvas does not document particle animation, so there is none.

H5082 sockets are `solar_plant_socket` (on=1, off=0). **Dump sockets** are Use=dump. **Manual sockets** are Use=normal. Where and Load are the text from Site solar. This table does not calculate watts.

text.fixed: T2 bus — device clamps (panels 1+2 are half-string estimates)
KU bus — MPPT 2/3 and PWM are estimates, not clamps
Sungold cart — not on the T2/KU DC bus
Site totals — computed in Node-RED, not extra clamps
